verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents serverless, pay-per-token access to popular open-source and open-weight models with no GPUs to size. It also claims 100+ supported models across text, vision, audio, image and embeddings, plus an open-weight recommended-models guide. However, the docs say on-demand deployments offer a wider selection than serverless, so the shared-endpoint catalog is only a subset. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the named families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS) are on serverless endpoints, a concrete serverless model list showing breadth and currency, independent corroboration.
